title: Identify European Red Spring switch arrays
changes: Identify and authenticate ten guarded switch destination arrays corresponding to 16 remaining sampled Red Spring words, preparing a concrete runtime-consumption increment.
validation: Wine disassembly 3ubkkgml and static source plan rtqw8txm verify ten roots, original guards, 148 same-state destinations and 592 source bytes; their roots are already owned, their destination spans do not overlap E222 sources, and 64 bytes overlap the remaining E172 sample.
limitations: Instruction scopes can include nested accesses; no destination ownership, guest-domain bound or complete caller coverage is claimed. Consumption, the other 104 sampled bytes, Linux, USA and native Windows remain open. Wine drained with the local overlay; no performance comparison was made.
